decisions.decision: Wait for Chief Sullivan in a couple of weeks to bring back the question of why the town is not eligible for the grant money, instead of speculating.
decisions.quote: it was agreed to wait for chief sullivan in a couple of weeks to bring that question back instead of speculating.

decisions.decision: Not to amend the May town meeting vote on the engine/ladder truck borrowing, but keep that vote, because borrowing later would carry a projected higher interest rate.
decisions.quote: the decision was made not to amend that but keep that vote because if we have to borrow a year down the road

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Terri clarified the stabilization line means depositing free cash to maintain 5%, not depositing 5% of free cash.
budget_items.quote: deposit free cash in the amount of 5%

budget_items.what_was_recorded: New growth has exceeded the forecast by about fifteen hundred thousand dollars; the trend ranged 360K-487K with last year around 472K.
budget_items.quote: the new growth has exceeded that by some fifteen hundred thousand dollars

budget_items.topic: State aid to schools (Chapter 70) and general government
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The governor's proposal is already $200K more for Lunenburg FY20, with a 2.7% increase in unrestricted general government and in Chapter 70.
budget_items.quote: the governor proposal is already $200k more for lunenburg fy20

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The forecast assumes the retirement assessment rises 10% per year, which John noted would double it about every 7 years.
budget_items.quote: 10% increase per year which would be a doubling of that every 7 years then?

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Last fall's free cash surplus stands at 1.5 million; the forecast sets aside $100K for stabilization, $200K for the special purpose stabilization, and $150K for OPEB.
budget_items.quote: $100k for stabilization, $200k for the special purpose stabilization, and $150k for opeb account

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Regular debt service falls about $50K from FY22-FY23 and about $120K from FY23-FY24; excludable debt drops by a million dollars FY23-24.
budget_items.quote: approximately a $50k reduction in our regular debt services

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The fuel tank cost is really $330K, with $110K from a previous capital article that has not been expended; the tanks are past their 25-year life span but not leaking.
budget_items.quote: terri clarified the cost for the fuel tanks at the dpw is really $330k, so the $110k

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The $167K in unexpended capital comes from $130K of asbestos abatement funds from the FY19 state budget and $25K from the police department (fingerprint machine received free from the state), plus minor closed-out lines.
budget_items.quote: terri asked for the town manager to speak on the $167k in unexpended capital

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A resident said the town is borrowing roughly $400k it hoped not to borrow; the $130K was not specifically designated to avoid borrowing.
budget_items.quote: we are borrowing roughly $400k that we hoped not to be borrowing at all
